messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++14 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <ctime>
#include <cassert>

#define lowbit(x) (x & (-x))
#define int long long

using namespace std;

inline int read() {
    int x = 0, f = 1;
    char ch = getchar();
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = -1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        x = x * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    return x * f;
}

inline void write(int x) {
    if (x < 0) {
        putchar('-');
        write(-x);
        return;
    }
    if (x >= 10) write(x / 10);
    putchar(x % 10 + '0');
}

inline void writesp(int x) {
    write(x);
    putchar(' ');
}

inline void writeln(int x) {
    write(x);
    putchar('\n');
}

inline void print(int x) {
    if (x == 0) putchar('0');
    if (x < 0) putchar('-'), x = -x;
    int s = 0, t = 0;
    while (x) {
        s = x % 10;
        x /= 10;
        t = t * 10 + s;
    }
    while (t) {
        putchar(t % 10 + '0');
        t /= 10;
    }
    while (s) {
        putchar(s % 10 + '0');
        s /= 10;
    }
}

inline void prints(int x) {
    print(x);
    putchar(' ');
}

inline void println(int x) {
    print(x);
    putchar('\n');
}

const int mod1 = 998244353, mod2 = 1e9 + 7;
vector<int> val[10];
int n, cnt1, cnt2, ans, sum[10], Pow[7] = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};
bool check(int x) {
    int now = 1000000;
    return x * now + 999999 <= n && x * now * 10 > n;
}

inline void dfs1(int x1, int x2) {
    if (x1 == 7) return;
    val[x1].push_back((cnt1 - x2 + mod1) % mod1);
    sum[x1] += (cnt1 - x2 + mod1) % mod1;
    cnt1++;
    for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++)
        dfs1(x1 + 1, x2 * 10 + i);
}

inline void dfs2(int x1, int x2) {
    if (x2 > n) return;
    if (check(x2)) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            int now = ((cnt2 + 1 - (x2 * Pow[i])) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1;
            int pos = lower_bound(val[i].begin(), val[i].end(), mod1 - now) - val[i].begin();
            (ans += (sum[i] + now * val[i].size() - mod1 * (val[i].size() - pos))) %= mod2;
        }
        cnt2 += cnt1;
    } else {
        cnt2++;
        (ans += ((cnt2 - x2) % mod1 + mod1)) %= mod2;
        for (int i = (x1 ? 0 : 1); i <= 9; i++)
            dfs2(x1 + 1, x2 * 10 + i);
    }
}

signed main() {
    n = read();
    dfs1(0, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++)
        sort(val[i].begin(), val[i].end());
    cnt2 = -1;
    dfs2(0, 0);
    writeln(ans);
}
